Name: (FS) Adventurer's Armor and Clothing
Author: TeaLovingLad
Description:
[size=3][center]﻿[b]Have a good look at the preview images on this page to see what you can expect![/b][/center][/size]
[size=3][u][b]Do note that the colors used in said images are merely placeholders, and that the items can be colored to your liking![/b][/u]
Hair may 'clip' through certain accessories of this mod. I recommend grabbing a FS pack that adds more hairstyles to adjust solve this issue.

I felt like there's a decent lack of adventurer-related gear. This Fashion Sense pack aims to remedy that, by adding a bunch of items with varying themes.
I offer you robust plate armor for knights, sturdy leather hats for cowboys, fancy attire for nobles and many other modular accessories to adorn your outfit for the next adventure![/size]
[b]

[size=4]Here are a bunch of example outfits you can create with the items of this pack:[/size]
[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/cMAniW3.png[/img]
[size=3]Note: A few of the clothing items come from other FS packs to complete these outfits, which I recommend checking out:[/size][list]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14154]FS - Vanilla Pants and Skirts[/url]﻿ by ﻿[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/violetlizabet?gameId=1303]violetelizabet[/url]﻿ for the dyeable vanilla pants/skirts[/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10317]FS - Vanilla Accessories[/url]﻿ by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Texadaeus?gameId=1303]Texadaeous[/url]﻿ for the beards used in some outfits[/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21838]FS - SH's Coats and Jackets Pack[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15431]FS - SH's Gloves and Sleeves Pack[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15417]FS - SH's Cottagecore Set[/url]﻿ by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/plurffle?gameId=1303]plurrfle[/url]﻿ for the sleeves and gloves used in various outfits as well as some of the cottagecore skirts and the duster[/size]
[/list][size=3]
Here are a few other FS packs that I'd like to recommend:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24966]Lighter Default Hair Mask[/url]﻿ by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/blkmmb?gameId=1303]blkmmb[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10659]SH's More Accessories and Stuff Pack[/url]﻿ by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/plurffle?gameId=1303]plurrfle[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10211]Backpacks and Baubles[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10837]Traveller's Attire[/url]﻿ by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/PeacefulEnd?gameId=1303]PeacefulEnd[/url]﻿[/size]
[/list][b][center]Thank you for at least considering to download this mod.
Now go on and have a good one of whatever you feel like![/center][/b]

Downloads.Description: Drop the zip file of this mod in your "Mods" folder and extract it there!
